rationale: Paper 2410.02315 discusses the emission mechanisms of LGRBs and llGRBs in the context of relativistic and choked jets, respectively, and their association with type Ic-BL supernovae. Paper 2004.05941 provides evidence supporting the scenario where some type Ic-BL supernovae are associated with off-axis GRBs or choked jets, contributing to understanding the relationship between these bursts and their progenitor supernovae.
